new_result.proof: a free-exiting pass in case (i) satisfies p < nu(p), i.e. it is a nu-ascent, so at most F of the free-exiting passes are case (i) and at least f_out - F are case (ii); in type A the three targets lie in three distinct orbits so those case-(ii) passes certify distinct split orbits, giving e >= f_out - F.  In type B F = 2 always and Round 127 already gives f_out <= 2 + e.
